name: source example counts only previously accepted requests
input: limit two, window six, six interleaved requests
test:
limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(2, 6)
requests = [(3, 'sam'), (4, 'sam'), (5, 'sam'), (6, 'lee'), (8, 'sam'), (10, 'sam')]
assert [limiter.allow(user, timestamp) for timestamp, user in requests] == [True, True, False, True, False, True]

name: the exact lower boundary remains in the window
input: accepted requests at times 0, 4, and 5 with a five-second window
test:
limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(2, 5)
assert limiter.allow('u', 0)
assert limiter.allow('u', 4)
assert not limiter.allow('u', 4)
assert limiter.allow('u', 5)
assert not limiter.allow('u', 8)
assert limiter.allow('u', 9)

name: users are independent and rejected requests do not consume a slot
input: two users and one rejected request
test:
limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(1, 10)
assert limiter.allow('red', 1)
assert not limiter.allow('red', 2)
assert limiter.allow('blue', 2)
assert limiter.allow('red', 11)
assert not limiter.allow('red', 12)
